scope: Two and three CPU/Gloo processes; three steps on tiny signed rank-one coordinate observations. Natural completion is separate from explicitly waited-before-return scheduling. Original and explicitly modified in-memory private-zero variant. No model, multi-GPU execution or performance benchmark.

private_zero.change: Wrap the receive-buffer input view in torch.zeros_like at both missing-gradient and padding sites

completion_schedules.complete_before_return: Wrapper waits for Gloo completion before returning its handle; forces a valid completed-before-next-iteration ordering

reports.momentum_checks: Each step independently checks state ownership, initialization and EMA values; a missing observation must preserve existing state.
reports.scope: Original and candidate classes use CPU allocation plus a storage-sharing flat Gloo output view. Completion is natural or explicitly completed before wrapper return. Tiny signed rank-one coordinate observations; no model, CUDA/NCCL multi-rank execution or performance benchmark.
